name: Colfenor's sapling
description: Colfenor's offspring, who rises one day after his death carrying his and his species' wisdom.

description_citations.text: "Colfenor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashling climbs Mount Tanufel, meets monks of the Ember Fell monastery and joins forces with Colfenor's sapling.
timeline.quote: The two joined forces to complete one of the tests set for Ashling by the monks.

citation.text: "Ashling", section "The Ember Fell Monastery". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Great Aurora ritual Ashling seizes the elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force, absorbing them; some energy goes to Maralen.
timeline.quote: she seized the unsuspecting elemental's power and the sapling's knowledge by force

citation.text: "Ashling", section "Destiny fulfilled". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Colfenor's sapling rises one day after his death, greeting the company as her seedfather's heir.
timeline.quote: the young tree had grown, awakened, and "risen" merely one day after Colfenor's death

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The sapling plays a role in the Great Aurora and the war between Oona and Maralen but does not survive; a cutting is saved and revived as Ferrafor.
timeline.quote: The sapling would not survive the ensuing conflict

citation.text: "Colfenor", section "Legacy". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

pages_say.description: The sapling of Colfenor who pursues Ashling to see the plan reach fruition and is set ablaze in the ritual.
